title: America’s Air Show 2026 Day 3: F-35C Lightning II
description: A U.S. Navy F-35C Lightning II conducts an aerial demonstration during the 2026 Marine Corps Air Station Miramar Air Show in San Diego, Sept. 27, 2026. With the F-35C Lightning II’s larger wings, reinforced landing gear, and tailhooks for catapult launches, it is designed for long-range strike missions and advanced stealth operations from aircraft carriers.  America's Air Show 2026 is a unique and incredible opportunity to witness Marine and joint aviation capabilities, civilian performers and the world-famous Blue Angels; to celebrate America’s 250th birthday alongside Marines and to see first-hand the innovative spirit of the Marine Corps through emerging technologies and forward-thinking. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Samuel Krause)
